player_prompt.intro:
Ovanga uakulonda {N} milonga ya uakulu usambulwa.
Ku kila kutatuka, ukwale [accept] kuchukua uakulu wa lunda, ka [continue] kukwata kuenda kuleka.
Uka kala ka chukua, ukalundwa kuchukua uakulu wa kuleka.
Ukaka (imbiru = 1) **kaka** uka uakulu waku chukua ndio wa uakulu wa yote.

invalid_move.wrong_format: O kijimbuete kia tokala o ku ki soneka mu mukanda iú, [accept] mba [continue].

outcome.summary: O wakabíle kási {value} ku kamba {draw_num}/{N}. Kási kikwímé kási {best}. {result}
